C-63.Name: Gate C-60 and C-62 in WebKit CI
C-63.Summary: Run the existing footnote-options and diagram-appearance WebKit projects from the test workflow after WebKit installation.
C-63.Problem: Chromium discovers both new specs, but test.yml never invokes their WebKit projects; local engine coverage would not remain enforced remotely.

Goals.R-1: The renderer-e2e job explicitly runs both existing WebKit projects and fails when either fails.
Goals.R-2: Retain existing CI triggers, jobs and release/version/tag behavior; document the gate under M-046 and V-M-046.

Constraints.Item: No release, tag, publication or dependency/version change. Keep other active changes intact.

NonGoals.Item: No product behavior change, new test framework or implementation of C-56/C-58/C-61.

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: Workflow YAML parses; a dedicated WebKit step invokes both project names after browser installation; both projects pass locally and the GRACE target validates.

C-63.Approval: The user authorized CI validation and push after local checks for C-60/C-62; wiring their already-approved browser gates into CI is a routine verification step within that instruction. Execute sequentially.
